headline: War Ledger Unmoved; Expanse Work Falls to No-Man's-Land
war_summary: Three hours on from the last edition, the war ledger stands exactly where it did: 436 works, of which the Colonials hold 309, the Wardens 121, and six lie unclaimed. The only territorial change of note came in Weathered Expanse, where a Colonial work passed into no-man's-land, leaving that much-fought region at five Colonial, one Warden, and three unclaimed after eighty-one events on the day. Mooring County remains the war's busiest ground with sixty-three events in twenty-four hours, though only two fell in the past two, and its casualty rate has cooled from the afternoon's peaks. Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua has gone quiet after eleven events earlier; Callahan's Passage, ten Warden works strong, has logged nothing in the past two hours. At StlicanShelf, three events in two hours touched Briar and Breaker Town, with casualties quickening there. OlavisWake's Koskinla flurry has left all five works in Warden hands and nothing recorded since late evening. Thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
